narr: A cluster of strong to severe storms over the Victoria Crossroads moved southeastward into Calhoun County and the Bays of the Middle to Upper Texas Coast. Severe wind gusts were reported in the morning of June 1st, with a later storm survey reporting two capsized boats, RV and shed completely destroyed, loss of shingles, and a snapped power pole near Magnolia Beach in Calhoun County.
ev: Calhoun Sheriff's Office reported local street flooding in Point Comfort along with hail. No estimate on hail size.
lsr: Calhoun Sheriffs Office reported local street flooding in Point Comfort with hail (no estimate) also occurring.
